conversation.speaker: Riley
conversation.text: OMG y’all, I just got the movie tickets for the Marvel premiere! We’re all going, right?

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Wait, are we doing this *tomorrow*? I thought it was next week!

conversation.speaker: Jordan
conversation.text: Duh, the first screening is tomorrow. You’re literally the only one who forgot.

conversation.speaker: Sam
conversation.text: I’ll bring the extra snacks—my mom made these insane superhero-themed cupcakes!

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Cupcakes? I’m in. But someone needs to remind me to bring the Monster Energy—this movie is *lit*.

conversation.speaker: Riley
conversation.text: Deal. And don’t worry, I’ll text you the theater location in 5. Also, who’s driving? My car’s in the shop again.

conversation.speaker: Jordan
conversation.text: I’ll drive. Just don’t make me wear the Spider-Man shirt again—still traumatized from last time.

conversation.speaker: Me
conversation.text: Fine, but I’m wearing my Iron Man hoodie. Let’s make it a theme!

conversation.speaker: Sam
conversation.text: I’m bringing the popcorn and drinks. If you guys want to survive, you’ll need more than cupcakes.

conversation.speaker: Riley
conversation.text: You’re a lifesaver, Sam. Now let’s just hope the movie isn’t *too* scary. I still can’t handle the Hulk’s roar.
